signals.text: My teenage daughter loves wearing these jogger sweatpants. They are a bit form fitting, but they are  soft and very comfortable. The medium size fits her well for the most part. She's 5'7" and weighs about 145 pounds. They're cuffed at the bottom of the legs so they should work on various heights. The legs are a little slim, but not tight. They wash well. Construction is good. There are no loose threads or seams.

I have a few clothes from Goodthreads, and very happy with them.
These jogging pants are heavy in weight, which is nice for the winter.
The inside of the pants are a soft fleece.
A size medium, made well, No loose threads, and are sown well.
